description: Senior year begins with Haley back in Tree Hill and Nathan unsure whether their marriage can be repaired. Peyton discovers a new connection to her birth family, Brooke and Lucas try again, Dan enters politics, and the year is permanently altered by tragedy at Tree Hill High and the truth Dan hides afterward.

s03e01.description: Lucas waits for Brooke's return, Peyton investigates the woman claiming to be her mother, and Nathan faces Haley's return as the Scott Motors fire is unraveled.

s03e02.description: Brooke's end-of-summer party exposes strained relationships as Nathan returns, Lucas struggles with Brooke's dating rules and Peyton absorbs new family truths.

s03e03.description: Senior year begins with Nathan and Haley awkwardly separated, Lucas learning troubling news about Peyton's mother and Dan closing in on the dealership fire.

s03e04.description: A masquerade at TRIC gives Haley and Brooke chances to reclaim old romances, while Peyton adjusts to Ellie and Dan escalates his battle with Deb.

s03e05.description: Basketball practice resumes under pressure as Nathan and Lucas clash, Rachel enters the cheerleading circle and Karen becomes an unexpected obstacle to Dan's mayoral plans.

s03e06.description: Brooke's fantasy-boy draft rearranges romantic pairings while Haley and Peyton argue over Nathan, Lucas strains under practice and the mayoral race heats up.

s03e07.description: The fantasy-draft dates produce awkward pairings and new attractions as Peyton struggles with Ellie and Karen and Deb intensify their campaign against Dan.

s03e08.description: The Ravens approach their opener with Lucas doubting himself, Brooke needing support and Dan resorting to increasingly ugly tactics in the mayoral race.

s03e09.description: Lucas reveals what he knows about the dealership fire, Brooke, Peyton and Haley land in jail, and Tree Hill finally chooses between Dan and Karen for mayor.

s03e10.description: Lucas and Peyton travel to find Ellie, Brooke's fashion business suddenly takes off and Deb admits to Nathan that she set the fire at Dan's dealership.

s03e11.description: Whitey challenges the struggling Ravens, Peyton and Ellie chase a band for their benefit album and Brooke plans a romantic surprise after Lucas backs her designs.

s03e12.description: A guidance assignment forces the seniors to confront their futures while a basketball scout raises the stakes for Lucas and Nathan and Peyton finishes Ellie's album.

s03e13.description: A violent storm traps Tree Hill in intimate confrontations, bringing Haley to Nathan, Brooke to Lucas and Peyton face-to-face with the reality of Ellie's illness.

s03e14.description: Brooke juggles a New York fashion opportunity with the cheer tournament, while Peyton reacts to Ellie's cancer and Nathan and Haley finally get overdue time together.

s03e15.description: The students' old time-capsule recordings are exposed as Peyton stages her benefit concert, forcing several friends to confront secrets they thought were safely buried.

s03e16.description: A student brings a gun to Tree Hill High, trapping classmates inside and forcing Lucas, Nathan and their friends into a crisis with irreversible consequences.

s03e17.description: Tree Hill struggles with grief after the school shooting while relationships are reassessed and Dan hides the truth about Keith's death.

s03e18.description: Rachel invites the group to her family's cabin, where games and surprises expose hidden feelings while Karen confronts Dan about Keith.

s03e19.description: Lucas questions returning to basketball, Brooke pushes Rachel to face her past, Nathan and Haley's renewed wedding plans are tested and Peyton heads for Chicago.

s03e20.description: With Lucas sidelined, Nathan carries the Ravens at the Coastal Classic while Brooke and Mouth target Rachel and Peyton makes a decision about her future.

s03e21.description: Nathan and Haley's rehearsal dinner becomes a collision of wedding stress, friendship tensions and a discovery that forces Peyton to reconsider her feelings.

s03e22.description: Nathan and Haley reach their wedding day as Peyton and Brooke's friendship fractures, Deb confesses the dealership fire and Karen faces life without Keith.
